name: STL_Tree_InsertUnique_IntKey_006a01f0
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall, ECX=tree, RET 0x8 at 006a026d, two callee-cleaned stack args: a 12-byte return slot for pair<iterator,bool> and a value pointer. Descends _Myhead->_Parent comparing *value against the signed int at node+0x0c; on an equal key returns {tree,node} with the flag byte 0, otherwise calls 0069f400 and sets the flag to 1 at 006a0265. Sole caller 006a0e90 at 006a102d is the hint-taking overload and copies only the first 8 bytes of the pair. Element types unrecovered. See docs/INPUT_SETTINGS_SMOKE.md.

name: STL_Tree_EraseSubtree_PooledPayload_006a0770
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall, ECX=tree kept in EBX only for the recursive call, RET 0x4, one stack arg = subtree root. Recurses on _Right(+8), steps to _Left(+0), releases a pooled buffer of count+1 bytes (count at node+0x0c, buffer at node+0x10) and frees the node via the thunk at 00bf65ac; _Isnil at +0x29 gives a 28-byte payload. Callers 006a1230 (clear) and 006a1aa0 (range erase) reset head, size and both extremes afterwards. Exported pseudocode is incomplete: Ghidra stops disassembling after the free call, leaving 006a07b1..006a07bb undefined (83 c4 04 80 7e 29 00 8b fe 74 c5 = ADD ESP,4 / CMP [ESI+0x29],0 / MOV EDI,ESI / JZ 006a0781), which is the loop back-edge.
